checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Who lends?
facts.text: WebBank makes the personal loans offered through Prosper. The page describes these loans as unsecured.

facts.label: APR and terms
facts.text: Advertised APRs are 8.99%–35.99% with terms of two to six years. The lowest rates are reserved for the most creditworthy applicants.

facts.label: Origination fee
facts.text: The published fee is 1%–9.99%. The fee reduces proceeds, so compare the amount received with the amount borrowed.

facts.label: Loan limit and approval
facts.text: Loans up to $50,000 depend on financial history, income, expenses and other factors. Approval is not guaranteed and funding requires sufficient investor commitments.
